handoff: Star field added as one MultiMeshInstance3D (game/galaxy/star_field.gd), created from map.gd with a one-line hook. 3000 stars, fixed seed, disc with 2 soft spiral arms, radius 40-220 world units so they never reach planets. Billboard quads with a small unshaded additive shader; brightness fades with camera distance (50 to 260), so far stars go dark. Camera orbit and zoom give parallax because stars are real 3D points. No collision, no input, no lights, no shadows, no per-frame script. Project loads headless with no script errors. Visual look and frame time unverified.
